subject: literacy
concept: Researching and evaluating secondary sources (literary criticism) relevant to a thesis question
source_inspiration: original content, building on P5 research skills — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sorts source summaries into 'directly relevant,' 'tangentially relevant,' and 'not relevant' to a given thesis
exercise.abstract: Student evaluates a set of secondary sources for relevance and credibility relative to their thesis question

misconception_flags: includes a source based on topic overlap alone without evaluating its actual relevance to the specific thesis

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
